description: Alpha Phone's key list for the offline release key ceremony: vendor/eliza/packages/os/scripts/android/generate-release-keys.ts --manifest android/signing/alpha-key-manifest.json (docs/human-actions.md H-08). It is the pinned upstream key-manifest.json entries the Pixel 10a image signing job uses (APK/module certificates, APEX container and payload keys, the OTA package key releasekey and the AVB key) plus the one Alpha application key. The upstream Ed25519 release-manifest and release-contract keys are left out: Alpha's update channel (android/aosp/pixel10a-ota-channel.json) does not use them. Names and parameters only, never key material. scripts/enroll-release-keys.mjs records the ceremony's public fingerprints.json in android/release-signer.json, android/aosp/pixel10a-product.json and android/aosp/pixel10a-ota-channel.json.

keys.name: releasekey
keys.consumer: APKs signed with testkey/releasekey; OTA package signature and otacerts.zip

keys.name: apex
keys.consumer: APEX container signature for all APEXes

keys.name: avb
keys.consumer: vbmeta and chained partitions; avb_pkmd.bin for avb_custom_key or factory fusing; release contract avb.publicKeySha256

keys.name: alphaphone_app
keys.consumer: Alpha Phone application APKs: the standalone and launcher releases and the Sense listener share this one certificate; android/release-signer.json signerSha256
keys.rotatable: only through an APK signature scheme v3 rotation lineage
